study: Paired bubble-free flow-on/off tissue-frame transport information test
information_gate: In the untouched evaluation session, each of the six motion-by-speed cells must have strictly positive lower 95% paired-bootstrap bounds for burst near-wall minus tissue-control on/off response and for its burst-minus-dense advantage. A pass indicates an information signature, never a blood filter or velocity-profile validation.
roi_rule: Before any flow-on scan, derive a fixed inner-wall lumen band and a tissue-control band separated by at least one pixel from the lumen from an independent structural scan; no source IQ or pump state selects pixels.
source_truth_policy: Only native unfiltered IQ enters B-mode registration and phase alignment. Geometry and independent optical/flowmeter records enter evaluation and input eligibility, never the feature transform.
